## Type

- [ ] Content fix or improvement (`content/`)
- [ ] New section or chapter
- [ ] Diagram or interactive widget (`src/diagrams/`)
- [ ] Site code, styles or tooling
- [ ] Docs

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run build` passes and I looked at the page in the browser (`npm run dev`)
- [ ] `npm run format:check` passes (run `npm run format` to fix)
- [ ] Prose is in my own words. I did not copy text from Red Hat training materials, books or other copyrighted sources.
- [ ] No personal data, real IP addresses, passwords or tokens (lab defaults such as `student`/`redhat` are fine)
- [ ] I agree that my contribution is licensed under the project's licenses (MIT for code, CC BY 4.0 for written content)
